name: DHS v. Thuraissigiam
summary: The Supreme Court upheld restrictions on habeas corpus review for asylum seekers in expedited removal, finding that the Constitution does not require the full panoply of procedural rights for noncitizens seeking to remain in the United States.
significance: The government cites this case for the proposition that noncitizens in expedited removal proceedings have limited constitutional rights to judicial review and that Congress may restrict court access in immigration cases.
